raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview


vLLM accepts but ignores OpenAI's `stream_options.include_obfuscation`, the mitigation OpenAI, Microsoft, Mistral and xAI deployed for the [Whisper Leak](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03675) side channel, so each streamed chunk's encrypted size reveals the length of its token. This PR implements the option for chat completions, completions and Responses, adds an opt-in server default `--enable-stream-obfuscation`, and documents both in the security guide.

## Claims


- `stream_options.include_obfuscation` works as in the OpenAI API, including the `include_obfuscation` query parameter on `GET /v1/responses/{id}?stream=true`.
- When enabled, chunks get an `obfuscation` field of random characters that rounds the JSON payload up to a multiple of 128 bytes. In live tests, unpadded content chunks had 6–11 distinct sizes per stream; padded chunks had one.
- Off by default. Without the flag, streams change only for requests that set `include_obfuscation: true`; with it, requests can opt out.

## Validation


Live server on an RTX 3090 with `Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct`: a script streamed each endpoint (and the Responses GET replay) with the option unset, true and false, against a default server, a server with `--enable-stream-obfuscation`, and the base commit. All 48 cases passed: padding appeared exactly when expected, every padded payload was a multiple of 128 bytes, and `openai` 3.29.0 parsed every stream. On the base commit, `include_obfuscation: true` had no effect.

```
pytest -k "not GPTOSS" tests/entrypoints/serve/utils/test_sse_obfuscation.py \
  tests/entrypoints/openai/test_stream_obfuscation.py \
  tests/entrypoints/launchers/test_cli_args.py \
  tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_serving_chat.py \
  tests/entrypoints/openai/test_render_parity.py \
  tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_{protocol,streaming_events,serving_responses}.py
# 376 passed, 10 deselected, 1 xfailed
```

The deselected GPT-OSS cases need a `gpt-oss-20b` server; they stream with obfuscation off, where the wrapper returns the stream unchanged, and are covered by CI. Rust: `cargo fmt`, `clippy -D warnings` and `cargo test -p vllm-cmd` pass, and `vllm-rs` rejects the new flag as unsupported.

To reproduce:

```bash
curl -sN localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{
  "model": "Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct", "stream": true, "max_tokens": 16,
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hi"}],
  "stream_options": {"include_obfuscation": true}}' \
| grep '^data: {' | while read -r l; do echo $(( ${#l} - 6 )); done   # all multiples of 128
```

## Details


**Motivation.** [Whisper Leak](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03675) showed that a network observer can classify the topic of streamed LLM conversations from TLS record sizes and timing (often above 98% AUPRC across 28 models). The provider mitigations followed its disclosure ([Microsoft](https://microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2025/11/07/whisper-leak-a-novel-side-channel-cyberattack-on-remote-language-models/)). Clients send `include_obfuscation` to whatever serves the endpoint, so a vLLM server facing clients directly needs to honor it.

**Design.** A router-level wrapper modeled on `with_sse_keep_alive` pads `data: {...}` events and leaves serving code untouched. Padding is random so compression can't remove it. For Responses only `*.delta` events are padded, as in the OpenAI API. Off by default because it adds 17–144 bytes per chunk. OpenAI pads by default; switching vLLM's default is a one-line change if maintainers prefer it. The flag is registered as unsupported in the Rust frontend, following #58830.

**Limitations.** A chunk's size still reveals whether its payload crosses a 128-byte boundary. Timing is not hidden; the paper found padding alone gives partial protection, so the docs also recommend `--stream-interval`. `/inference/v1/generate` and the Rust frontend are not covered (noted in the docs).  **I can follow up with Rust support once the design here is settled.**

**Duplicates and AI use.** No issue or PR mentions `include_obfuscation`, stream obfuscation or Whisper Leak (searched 2026-10-12). Claude Code assisted with research, implementation, tests and the validation scripts. I made the scope and design decisions, reviewed every changed line and the validation results.

---

@@ -637,6 +637,36 @@ Scope the salt to the isolation boundary you need:
 - **Single-tenant deployments**: Cache salting is unnecessary and can be omitted to maximize cache hit rates.
 - Salting reduces cache efficiency, since cached blocks are only reusable by requests with the same salt. Choose the granularity of your salt values to balance privacy against performance.
 
+## Streaming Token-Length Side-Channel Mitigation (Stream Obfuscation)
+
+### Background
+
+TLS encrypts the content of a streamed response but not the size or timing of each record. By default each SSE chunk carries a single token, so an observer on the network path can recover the length of every generated token. Research has shown that classifiers trained on these sequences can identify the topic of a conversation with high accuracy. See [Whisper Leak](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03675) for details.
+
+### Stream Obfuscation
+
+When stream obfuscation is enabled, vLLM adds an `obfuscation` field of random characters to each streamed chunk, rounding the size of its JSON payload up to a multiple of 128 bytes. Most chunks in a stream then have the same size, regardless of token length. This follows the OpenAI API's `stream_options.include_obfuscation` option and applies to `/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/completions`, and the delta events of `/v1/responses`. Clients that parse chunks as JSON can ignore the field. It does not apply to the token-level `/inference/v1/generate` endpoint or to the Rust frontend.
+
+Stream obfuscation is disabled by default. Start the server with `--enable-stream-obfuscation` to enable it for all streaming requests. Individual requests can override the server default:
+
+```python
+stream = client.chat.completions.create(
+    model=model,
+    messages=messages,
+    stream=True,
+    stream_options={"include_obfuscation": True},
+)
+```
+
+For `GET /v1/responses/{response_id}?stream=true`, pass `include_obfuscation` as a query parameter.
+
+### Recommendations
+
+- **Clients streaming directly from vLLM over untrusted networks**: Start the server with `--enable-stream-obfuscation`.
+- **vLLM behind a gateway**: The client-facing stream is produced by the gateway. Make sure the gateway forwards the `obfuscation` field unchanged or applies its own padding.
+- Obfuscation hides token lengths but not token timing. `--stream-interval` sends several tokens per chunk, which further reduces the information exposed at the cost of streaming granularity.
+- Obfuscation adds 17 to 144 bytes per chunk. Leave it disabled when clients and server communicate over a trusted network.
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Stream obfuscation routing: each streaming OpenAI endpoint honors
+``stream_options.include_obfuscation`` and falls back to
+``--enable-stream-obfuscation``."""
+
+import json
+from argparse import Namespace
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi import FastAPI
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from openai.types.responses import ResponseTextDeltaEvent
+from pydantic import BaseModel
+
+from vllm.entrypoints.openai.chat_completion import api_router as chat_router
+from vllm.entrypoints.openai.completion import api_router as completion_router
+from vllm.entrypoints.openai.responses import api_router as responses_router
+
+_CHUNK = 'data: {"choices": [{"index": 0, "delta": {"content": "hi"}}]}\n\n'
+
+
+class _OtherEvent(BaseModel):
+    type: str = "response.completed"
+
+
+async def _chunks():
+    yield _CHUNK
+    yield "data: [DONE]\n\n"
+
+
+async def _events():
+    yield ResponseTextDeltaEvent(
+        content_index=0,
+        delta="hi",
+        item_id="msg_1",
+        logprobs=[],
+        output_index=0,
+        sequence_number=1,
+        type="response.output_text.delta",
+    )
+    yield _OtherEvent()
+
+
+class _Handler:
+    async def create_chat_completion(self, request, raw_request):
+        return _chunks()
+
+    async def create_completion(self, request, raw_request):
+        return _chunks()
+
+    async def create_responses(self, request, raw_request):
+        return _events()
+
+    async def retrieve_responses(self, response_id, *, starting_after, stream):
+        return _events()
+
+
+def _client(server_default: bool) -> TestClient:
+    app = FastAPI()
+    app.state.args = Namespace(enable_stream_obfuscation=server_default)
+    for module in (chat_router, completion_router, responses_router):
+        module.attach_router(app)
+    handler = _Handler()
+    app.state.openai_serving_chat = handler
+    app.state.openai_serving_completion = handler
+    app.state.openai_serving_responses = handler
+    return TestClient(app)
+
+
+def _data_payloads(body: str) -> list[dict]:
+    return [
+        json.loads(line[len("data: ") :])
+        for line in body.split("\n")
+        if line.startswith("data: {")
+    ]
+
+
+def _post(client: TestClient, path: str, include_obfuscation: bool | None) -> str:
+    body: dict = {"model": "m", "stream": True}
+    if path == "/v1/chat/completions":
+        body["messages"] = [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]
+    elif path == "/v1/completions":
+        body["prompt"] = "hi"
+    else:
+        body["input"] = "hi"
+    if include_obfuscation is not None:
+        body["stream_options"] = {"include_obfuscation": include_obfuscation}
+    response = client.post(path, json=body)
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    return response.text
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "path", ["/v1/chat/completions", "/v1/completions", "/v1/responses"]
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("server_default", "include_obfuscation", "expected"),
+    [
+        (False, None, False),
+        (True, None, True),
+        (True, False, False),
+        (False, True, True),
+    ],
+)
+def test_request_option_and_server_default(
+    path, server_default, include_obfuscation, expected
+):
+    body = _post(_client(server_default), path, include_obfuscation)
+    first = _data_payloads(body)[0]
+    assert ("obfuscation" in first) is expected
+
+
+def test_responses_pads_only_delta_events():
+    body = _post(_client(server_default=True), "/v1/responses", None)
+    delta, other = _data_payloads(body)
+    assert "obfuscation" in delta
+    assert "obfuscation" not in other
+
+
+def test_retrieve_responses_honors_query_parameter():
+    client = _client(server_default=False)
+    url = "/v1/responses/resp_1?stream=true"
+    assert "obfuscation" not in client.get(url).text
+    padded = client.get(url + "&include_obfuscation=true").text
+    assert "obfuscation" in _data_payloads(padded)[0]

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import json
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.entrypoints.serve.utils.sse_keep_alive import SSE_KEEP_ALIVE_COMMENT
+from vllm.entrypoints.serve.utils.sse_obfuscation import (
+    OBFUSCATION_BLOCK_SIZE,
+    obfuscate_sse_chunk,
+    should_obfuscate,
+    with_sse_obfuscation,
+)
+
+
+def _chunk(content: str) -> str:
+    payload = {
+        "id": "chatcmpl-1",
+        "object": "chat.completion.chunk",
+        "choices": [{"index": 0, "delta": {"content": content}}],
+    }
+    return f"data: {json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)}\n\n"
+
+
+def _payload(frame: str) -> str:
+    assert frame.startswith("data: ") and frame.endswith("\n\n")
+    return frame[len("data: ") : -2]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("requested", "server_default", "expected"),
+    [
+        (None, False, False),
+        (None, True, True),
+        (True, False, True),
+        (False, True, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_request_overrides_server_default(requested, server_default, expected):
+    assert should_obfuscate(requested, server_default) is expected
+
+
+def test_disabled_returns_same_generator():
+    """Disabled obfuscation must add no wrapper or per-chunk work."""
+
+    async def gen():
+        yield "x"
+
+    g = gen()
+    assert with_sse_obfuscation(g, enabled=False) is g
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("token", ["a", "hello", " world!", "é", "日本語"])
+def test_padding_rounds_up_to_block(token):
+    """Payloads, including multi-byte UTF-8, are padded to the next block
+    boundary and no further."""
+    frame = _chunk(token)
+    unpadded = len(_payload(frame).encode()) + len(',"obfuscation":""')
+    size = len(_payload(obfuscate_sse_chunk(frame)).encode())
+    assert size % OBFUSCATION_BLOCK_SIZE == 0
+    assert 0 <= size - unpadded < OBFUSCATION_BLOCK_SIZE
+
+
+def test_token_lengths_are_hidden():
+    """Across typical token lengths, chunk sizes reveal at most whether a
+    token crosses one block boundary, not its length."""
+    sizes = {
+        len(_payload(obfuscate_sse_chunk(_chunk("x" * n))).encode())
+        for n in range(1, 17)
+    }
+    assert len(sizes) <= 2
+
+
+def test_payload_is_preserved():
+    """Padding adds only the `obfuscation` field; existing fields and the SSE
+    framing are unchanged."""
+    frame = _chunk('say "hi"\n\\ ok')
+    padded = obfuscate_sse_chunk(frame)
+    original = json.loads(_payload(frame))
+    obfuscated = json.loads(_payload(padded))
+    obfuscation = obfuscated.pop("obfuscation")
+    assert obfuscated == original
+    assert isinstance(obfuscation, str)
+
+
+def test_padding_is_random():
+    """Fixed padding could be removed by HTTP compression."""
+    paddings = {
+        json.loads(_payload(obfuscate_sse_chunk(_chunk("a"))))["obfuscation"]
+        for _ in range(8)
+    }
+    assert len(paddings) > 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "frame", ["data: [DONE]\n\n", SSE_KEEP_ALIVE_COMMENT, "data: not-json\n\n"]
+)
+def test_non_json_frames_pass_through(frame):
+    assert obfuscate_sse_chunk(frame) == frame
+
+
+def test_event_suffix_limits_padding_to_matching_events():
+    """Responses streams pad only `*.delta` events, as upstream does."""
+    delta = 'event: response.output_text.delta\ndata: {"delta": "hi"}\n\n'
+    done = 'event: response.completed\ndata: {"type": "done"}\n\n'
+    assert "obfuscation" in obfuscate_sse_chunk(delta, event_suffix=".delta")
+    assert obfuscate_sse_chunk(done, event_suffix=".delta") == done
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_stream_pads_chunks_and_closes_upstream():
+    closed = False
+
+    async def gen():
+        nonlocal closed
+        try:
+            yield _chunk("a")
+            yield "data: [DONE]\n\n"
+        finally:
+            closed = True
+
+    out = [chunk async for chunk in with_sse_obfuscation(gen(), enabled=True)]
+    assert "obfuscation" in json.loads(_payload(out[0]))
+    assert out[1] == "data: [DONE]\n\n"
+    assert closed

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Stream obfuscation for SSE responses.
+
+TLS hides the content of a streamed response but not the size of each record.
+With one token per chunk, a passive network observer can recover every token's
+length and use the sequence to infer the topic of a conversation (Whisper Leak,
+https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03675). ``with_sse_obfuscation`` wraps the final SSE
+generator and adds an ``obfuscation`` field of random characters to each JSON
+``data:`` payload, padding it to a multiple of ``OBFUSCATION_BLOCK_SIZE`` bytes.
+This implements OpenAI's ``stream_options.include_obfuscation``.
+
+Rounding sizes up to a block boundary, rather than padding by a random amount,
+reduces what a chunk's size reveals to a single bit: whether its payload
+crosses the next boundary. The block is large relative to typical token lengths
+so that this is rare. The padding is random so that HTTP compression cannot
+strip it.
+"""
+
+import secrets
+from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
+
+OBFUSCATION_BLOCK_SIZE = 128
+_FIELD_PREFIX = '"obfuscation":"'
+
+
+def should_obfuscate(requested: bool | None, server_default: bool) -> bool:
+    """Resolve a request's ``include_obfuscation`` against the server default."""
+    return server_default if requested is None else requested
+
+
+def with_sse_obfuscation(
+    generator: AsyncGenerator[str, None],
+    enabled: bool,
+    event_suffix: str | None = None,
+) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
+    """Pad the JSON payloads of ``generator`` when ``enabled``.
+
+    A disabled call returns ``generator`` unchanged. If ``event_suffix`` is set,
+    only SSE events whose ``event:`` name ends with it are padded.
+    """
+    if not enabled:
+        return generator
+    return _obfuscated_stream(generator, event_suffix)
+
+
+async def _obfuscated_stream(
+    generator: AsyncGenerator[str, None],
+    event_suffix: str | None,
+) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
+    try:
+        async for chunk in generator:
+            yield obfuscate_sse_chunk(chunk, event_suffix)
+    finally:
+        await generator.aclose()
+
+
+def obfuscate_sse_chunk(chunk: str, event_suffix: str | None = None) -> str:
+    """Pad every JSON ``data:`` payload in ``chunk``, which may hold several
+    events. Comments, ``[DONE]`` and non-JSON payloads pass through."""
+    if "data: {" not in chunk:
+        return chunk
+    return "\n\n".join(
+        _obfuscate_event(event, event_suffix) for event in chunk.split("\n\n")
+    )
+
+
+def _obfuscate_event(event: str, event_suffix: str | None) -> str:
+    lines = event.split("\n")
+    if event_suffix is not None and not any(
+        line.startswith("event: ") and line.endswith(event_suffix) for line in lines
+    ):
+        return event
+    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
+        if line.startswith("data: {") and line.endswith("}"):
+            lines[i] = "data: " + _pad_json_object(line[len("data: ") :])
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def _pad_json_object(payload: str) -> str:
+    prefix = _FIELD_PREFIX if payload == "{}" else "," + _FIELD_PREFIX
+    # The payload's closing brace is reused; the field adds its prefix and a
+    # closing quote.
+    size = len(payload.encode()) + len(prefix) + 1
+    pad_len = -size % OBFUSCATION_BLOCK_SIZE
+    # URL-safe base64 needs no JSON escaping, so each character is one byte.
+    padding = secrets.token_urlsafe(pad_len)[:pad_len]
+    return f'{payload[:-1]}{prefix}{padding}"}}'
